description.zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)获取物理库ID的值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~)获取逻辑库ID的值。
>DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to query the ID of a physical database and the [ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~) operation to query the ID of a logical database.

>  The value of the DatabaseId parameter is that of the DbId parameter.

description.zh:
权限类型，取值：
- INSTANCE: 实例权限
- DATABASE： 物理库权限
- LOGIC_DATABASE：逻辑库权限
- TABLE：物理表权限
- LOGIC_TABLE：逻辑表权限
description.en:
The permissions on a specific type of object that you want to grant to the user. Valid values:

*   INSTANCE: permissions on instances
*   DATABASE: permissions on physical databases
*   LOGIC_DATABASE: permissions on logical databases
*   TABLE: permissions on physical tables
*   LOGIC_TABLE: permissions on logical tables
The time when the permissions expire.

description.zh: 实例ID，授权实例权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口[ListInstances](~~141936~~)或[GetInstance](~~141567~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the instance. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on an instance to the user. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

description.zh:
是否是逻辑库，授权数据库权限时需要指定。取值：
- true：逻辑库
- false：物理库
description.en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a database to the user. Valid values:

*   true: The database is a logical database.
*   false: The database is a physical database.

description.zh:
权限类型，取值如下：
- **QUERY**：查询
- **EXPORT**：导出
- **CORRECT**：变更
- **LOGIN**：登录权限
- **PERF**：实例性能查看权限
description.en:
The permission type. Separate multiple permission types with commas (,). Valid values:

*   **QUERY**: the query permissions
*   **EXPORT**: the export permissions
*   **CORRECT**: the change permissions
*   **LOGIN**: the logon permissions
*   **PERF**: the query permissions on the performance details of the instance

description.zh: 表ID，授权表权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口[ListTables](~~141878~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the table. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a table to the user. You can call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation to query the table ID.

description.zh: 表名，授权表权限时需要指定。
description.en: The name of the table. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a table to the user.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the [Manage DMS tenants](~~181330~~) topic.

description.zh:
用户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUser](~~147098~~)或[ListUsers](~~141938~~)获取该参数的值。
>用户ID不是用户的阿里云Uid。
description.en:
The ID of the user. You can call the [GetUser](~~147098~~) or [ListUsers](~~141938~~) operation to query the ID of the user.

>  The user ID is different from the ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise grant-user-permission --tid 3000 --user-id 510000 --ds-type DATABASE --instance-id 1740000 --db-id 1000 --logic false --table-id 132000 --table-name table_name --perm-types QUERY --expire-date 2021-12-12_00:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise GrantUserPermission --region cn-hangzhou --TableId 132000 --TableName table_name --PermTypes QUERY --ExpireDate '2021-12-12_00:00:00' --InstanceId 1740000 --UserId 510000 --DbId 1000 --Logic false --Tid 3000 --DsType DATABASE
